title: Update AGENTS.md to enforce small-step workflow
description: Update the AGENTS.md file at the project root to add a mandatory 'Small-Step Workflow' section. It must state that agents MUST only do one small step at a time, verify it works (tests pass, no errors), and ONLY THEN move to the next step. This is essential and must never be forgotten. Add it near the top, right after Quickstart or in a dedicated 'Workflow Rules' section. Also add a Gotcha about it.

Also, there is a top-level brave search API selection/toggle, and per-bot Brave Search API keys. If the top-level brave API setting has been configured, the per-bot Brave Search API key should default to that value.
